castle.text: Move the king two squares, or drop the king and rook onto each other.

plan.text: Right-drag for legal move arrows; knights bend into an L. Each arrow describes the current position, not a sequence. Right-click circles a square. Freeform allows notes from empty squares. On mobile, use Draw arrows.

squareControl.text: In Explore, green means White attacks a square, coral means Black, and gold means both. Uncolored squares are unattacked. Counts include pinned pieces and defended friendly pieces; control does not guarantee a safe move.

analysis.text: In Games and Explore, Stockfish analyzes every position automatically: the bar shows the evaluation and the arrow its best move. Turn either off in the Stockfish panel. Positive scores favor White; a score is an estimate, not a guaranteed result.

moveMarks.text: Move ratings: !! Brilliant, ! Great, star Best, checkmark Good, book Book, ?! Inaccuracy, ? Mistake, ?? Blunder. Each analysed move counts once.

navigate.text: The left and right arrow keys step through moves. F flips the board.

links.text: Every screen has its own address, including the move you are on. Bookmark it or use the browser’s back button.
